scepter_loc.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

subject: dawnbreaker_solar_guardian
definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）
evidence: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within %max_offset_distance% units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for %daytime_duration%s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄%max_offset_distance%距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续%daytime_duration%秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
notes_en: Pulse interval is %pulse_interval%s.
Total flight duration is %abilitychanneltime% seconds of channel time + %airtime_duration% of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
notes_zh: 脉冲间隔为%pulse_interval%秒。
总飞行时间为%abilitychanneltime%秒持续施法时间 + %airtime_duration%秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。

scepter_loc.en: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for %scepter_aura_duration%s after landing.
scepter_loc.zh: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随%scepter_aura_duration%秒。

subject: drow_ranger_multishot
definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）
evidence: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
notes_en: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

subject: elder_titan_echo_stomp
definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）
evidence: 持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。
CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
notes_en: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
notes_zh: 若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。

shard_loc.en: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.
shard_loc.zh: 减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。

evidence: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.
持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。

scepter_loc.en: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to %scepter_pct_damage%%% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a %scepter_radius% AoE. Pulls at a rate of %scepter_drag_speed%.
scepter_loc.zh: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位%scepter_pct_damage%%%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个%scepter_radius%范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为%scepter_drag_speed%。

definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）

持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。
CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.
在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。
Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
notes_en: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.
notes_zh: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。

scepter_loc.en: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of %aoe_scepter% in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.
scepter_loc.zh: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域%aoe_scepter%范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

subject: lion_mana_drain
definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）
evidence: 持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by %movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%.  Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a %ally_pct%%% rate.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升%movespeed_bonus_when_empty_pct%%%。可以对友军施放，给予他们%ally_pct%%%魔法和移动速度。
notes_en: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
notes_zh: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。

shard_loc.en: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to %shard_bonus_targets% additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with %magic_resist%%% magic resistance while channeling.
shard_loc.zh: 法力吸取可以作用最多%shard_bonus_targets%个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得%magic_resist%%%魔法抗性。

subject: meepo_poof
definition: 施法者自身需要持续引导，被打断即停止
definition_note: U51：别的单位引导（恶魔之扉使用者）或由它给出的技能引导（丛林之舞的乾坤之跃）不算；字段CHANNELLED不一定等于用户口径（蛛纱陷阱不算）
evidence: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations.

game_file_fields.AbilityBehavior: DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NORMAL_WHEN_STOLEN | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_IGNORE_BACKSWING | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ROOT_DISABLES | DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_ALT_CASTABLE

context.description_en: Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for %cast_duration% seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
context.description_zh: 通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法%cast_duration%秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
notes_en: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.
notes_zh: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

subject: primal_beast_pulverize

evidence: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE.

context.description_en: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts %channel_time% seconds.
context.description_zh: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续%channel_time%秒。
